name: skillknot
description: Reusable skills for AI coding agents

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: Hostile expert-panel review of one or more items against audiences, styles, standards and obligations, by region

plugins.name: capability-ladder
plugins.description: When a task exposes a missing capability: check what exists, pick the cheapest fix, propose before installing

plugins.name: claude-code-guards
plugins.description: Claude Code hooks that ask before pushes, destructive commands and connector sends, keep secrets out of reach, flag prompt injection, plus a hardened settings template

plugins.name: claude-code-session-meter
plugins.description: A Claude Code status line for branch, unpushed work, context, cost and time, plus a cap that warns when a session runs long or costly, and a handoff reminder

plugins.name: context-budget
plugins.description: Measure an agent setup's always-loaded context and hook latency against budgets, and fix by relocating

plugins.name: document-bundle
plugins.description: Keep one source document and derive every audience version from it, so copies never drift

plugins.name: gauntlet
plugins.description: Improve one existing item against a stated bar, inside a spending cap

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: End a working session with nothing left only in the chat: sweep, persist, release, verify, report

plugins.name: obsidian-canvas
plugins.description: Build, lay out and verify Obsidian canvas files that read as an argument, not a picture

plugins.name: ownership-map
plugins.description: Trace who ultimately controls a company, what else they hold, and where interests align

plugins.name: polish-document
plugins.description: Turn a rough capture into a professional document: gaps first, then review, format and diagrams

plugins.name: private-words
plugins.description: Keep private words out of a repo, with the list held only where the user chooses

plugins.name: read-only-researcher
plugins.description: Research web questions and report sourced findings, without acting or sending anything

plugins.name: taxonomy-review
plugins.description: Review a folder or category structure and recommend merges and splits, without moving anything

plugins.name: verdict-first
plugins.description: A verdict-first, low-filler reply style for readers who skim, with a Claude Code output style
